Name: (CP) Grandpa's Shed Recolour - Earthy VPR and SSS Inspired (SVE)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

I got peeved looking at people's lovely farm-design screenshots and having Grandpa's Shed sticking out like a sore thumb as the rest of map would be heavily desaturated. So I created this recolour!

There's two variations of Shed recolour Brown and White, which you can pick using the Generic Mod Config Menu.

Includes the Destroyed and Built versions.

Let me know if there's any bugs or if you'd like me to add anything!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder

[/*]
[*]You're all done!

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img][/url]

Added compatibility with green fall mods! Be sure to check the generic mod config menu to switch.
